agentdoc.description: High-performance CLI & MCP document/code toolkit for AI agents. Inspects, searches, edits, converts, and visually snapshots documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, Markdown, code, and images).
capabilities: search_code: Multi-threaded regex/exact text search in files with before/after context lines
search_files: Fast recursive directory crawler matching glob patterns
read_lines: Exact 1-based line reading with line numbers and boundary checks
replace_lines: Atomic line replacement via temp file swap to avoid corruption
insert_lines: Insert lines before or after specific line numbers
delete_lines: Delete line ranges from code or text files
concat_files: Concatenate files with custom headers and delimiters
clean_file: Strip ANSI codes, remove blank lines, trim trailing whitespace, regex substitution
sheets_info: Inspect sheet names, row counts, and column headers in XLSX workbooks
sheets_set_cell: Update specific cell value in an XLSX workbook
sheets_get_cell: Read specific cell value from an XLSX workbook
sheets_add_row: Append a row of data to an XLSX worksheet
docs_read: Extract structured Markdown or plain text from Word DOCX files
docs_snapshot: Render visual preview PNG screenshot of Word DOCX for AI vision models
pdf_read: Extract plain text from PDF documents (full or page-by-page)
pdf_snapshot: Render visual preview PNG screenshots of individual, range, or all PDF pages
image_extract: Extract all embedded images and media from PDF, DOCX, or XLSX documents
convert: Universal cross-format converter between Markdown, DOCX, PDF, XLSX, CSV, and images
